Read audit/recorder.ts, agent/loop.ts, tools/executor.ts, tools/approvals.ts, workers/reminders.ts, integrations/payments.ts, k8s CronJob and terraform state tables. Audit is write-only to Firehose/S3, the loop keeps state in memory, the CronJob has backoffLimit 0, and no code reads logs or checkpoints back or retries automatically. The only DynamoDB 'recovery' hit is point-in-time recovery, which is infrastructure backup and not agent-driven.
